name: SteamVaults
tagline: Buy or sell Steam Sacks of Gems with USDT through a guided trade flow
desc_full: SteamVaults is an independent third-party service for one supported Steam item: Sack of Gems. Users can buy Sacks with USDT to top up Steam Wallet after selling on the Community Market, or sell tradable Sacks for USDT. The flow shows a quote, sends a Steam trade offer, and requires the user to approve it in Steam Mobile. Sell proceeds first reach a SteamVaults balance; Polygon USDT withdrawal is a separate step. SteamVaults is not affiliated with Valve or Steam. Steam holds and account or item restrictions still apply.ㅡ
builder_bio: I build SteamVaults, an independent service focused on a clear, limited Steam item workflow. The project explains prices, trade steps, and restrictions without presenting itself as affiliated with Valve or Steam.
builder_story: Steam item values are easy to misunderstand: a Community Market price, Steam Wallet spending power, and a third-party cash quote are not the same thing. SteamVaults was built to make one narrow flow explicit instead of pretending to support every item. It currently supports only Sack of Gems, shows the quote and required trade steps, and keeps Steam approval in the user's hands.Steam item values are easy to misunderstand: a Community Market price, Steam Wallet spending power, and a third-party cash quote are not the same thing. name: Picturesque AI
tagline: All-in-one AI creative studio with 100+ models
desc_full: Picturesque AI is an all-in-one AI creative studio. Instead of juggling a dozen logins for Kling, Veo, Flux, GPT Image 2, Suno, and Topaz, you work in one credit-based workspace with 100+ image, video, audio, and editing models. A Director LLM helps you brief and iterate, and reusable Workflows let you save the setups you actually ship. Freemium.
builder_bio: Founder of Picturesque AI. Building an all-in-one AI creative studio so creators can ship stills, motion, and sound from one credit-based workspace instead of juggling a dozen model logins.
builder_story: Creators were bouncing between a dozen logins just to ship one campaign. We built Picturesque AI so image, video, audio, and editing models live in one credit-based studio with a Director LLM and reusable Workflows.

name: UnfollowKit
tagline: Free TikTok unfollower tracker for creators
desc_full: UnfollowKit is a free TikTok unfollowers tracker for creators who want to clean up their following list and understand follower changes. It identifies accounts that do not follow you back and tracks lost followers over time without asking for a TikTok password or a TikTok data-file upload.
builder_bio: The UnfollowKit team builds lightweight social media utilities for creators who want clearer follower insights without giving up unnecessary account access.
builder_story: We built UnfollowKit because TikTok creators often need a quick, privacy-conscious way to audit who follows back without sharing passwords or exporting account files. The goal is to keep follower cleanup simple and transparent for small creators.

name: AnyLend
tagline: Permissionless DeFi lending pools with segmented risk
desc_full: AnyLend is a permissionless DeFi protocol that lets anyone create isolated lending pools with configurable collateral markets and interest rates. Segmented risk keeps problems in one pool from spilling into healthy markets.
builder_bio: AnyLend Team builds permissionless DeFi infrastructure focused on isolated lending markets and transparent risk parameters.
builder_story: We built AnyLend around a simple DeFi risk principle: lending markets should be isolated so a risky asset or exploit does not contaminate unrelated pools.

name: LynoTV
tagline: Android media player for authorized M3U and Xtream sources
desc_full: LynoTV is an Android media player for people who already have M3U playlists or Xtream Codes access they are authorized to use. It works on Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV, phones and tablets. The Free plan includes playback, profiles, favourites, viewing progress and parental controls. Optional Premium adds encrypted synchronization across compatible devices with explicit consent and removes advertising. LynoTV does not provide channels, playlists, subscriptions or audiovisual content.
builder_bio: LynoTV is an independent Android media-player project focused on a clear, reliable experience for user-authorized media sources. The project keeps the player separate from content providers and offers optional encrypted synchronization across compatible devices.
builder_story: Many Android users already have authorized M3U or Xtream Codes access but need a consistent interface across television, phone and tablet. LynoTV was built to provide that focused player experience while remaining separate from content providers and making the legal boundary explicit.
